text:
ana: Heads up — invoice preview delta spike for a subset of tenants after yesterday's routing policy canary. Seeing +20-30% token counts on the preview vs raw ingest for the same window.
raj: Which canary? the new fallback-priority routing we rolled at 03:00? :thinking_face:
maria: Yup that's the one. Canary cohort is 12% of prod traffic. I saw a similar blip in the quota dashboard earlier.
kevin: I pulled sample events. Looks like requests routed to fallback variant got re-emitted to the billing pipeline twice during short retries. Possibly a callback replay from the proxy layer.
lina: Replays would explain duplicates. Are the events dedup keys present? We rely on request_fingerprint + sequence_id as dedupe key.
ana: (typo) I meant ana: We use fingerprint but sequence_id is optional for old clients. If proxy adds a new header during fallback it could change fingerprinting.
raj: Can you paste an example event? I want to check fingerprint composition.
maria: sample event snippet:
```
{"client_id":"acme","path":"/v1/generate","req_id":"r-123","fingerprint":"fp:sha1( client+path+ip )","retry":1}
```
kevin: That sample shows fingerprint includes ip. When we route to fallback, proxy swaps upstream ip header to the fallback host -> fingerprint changes -> billing sees it as a different session and then later sees the original, counts twice.
lina: So two problems: fingerprinting includes non-stable field (ip), and fallback flow modifies that header. Fix path A: remove ip from billing fingerprint. Fix path B: ensure proxy preserves stable provenance header.
raj: Short-term mitigation: expand dedupe window and also use session token where present to join events. We can add logic in the billing-ingest to prefer session_token if present.
maria: Agree. Also add quick rule in canary to disable fallback retry path that mutates headers while we patch.
billing-bot: [info] invoice-preview job started for cohort snapshot id 2026-03-19T03:00Z-canary
kevin: Proposed SQL to retro-dedupe recent 24h invoices on invoice_preview:
```
-- dedupe by coalescing on session_token then fingerprint
DELETE FROM invoice_preview p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM invoice_preview p2
  WHERE p2.session_token IS NOT NULL
  AND p2.session_token = p.session_token
  AND p2.id < p.id
);
```
lina: That would help previews but not the raw event count used for actual invoices. We should not modify final invoices without approvals.
ana: (ana) typo: we're aligned on previews only. For final invoices we run a proper reconciliation and legal review.
raj: Ops plan:
1) revert header-mangling fallback in proxy canary within 30 min (deploy-bot runbook step)
2) roll billing-ingest patch to prefer session_token for dedupe (hotfix)
3) widen preview dedupe window + backfill for the last 48h
4) schedule model for removing ip from fingerprint (longer term)
kevin: I'll open a PR for the billing-ingest patch and add unit tests for header-variation cases.
maria: I'll coordinate with infra to rollback the proxy change in canary. deploy-bot pls when ready.
deploy-bot: starting rollback: proxy-fallback-canary @canary-group
billing-bot: [warn] invoice-preview delta alert suppressed for canary cohort while mitigation in progress
ana: Thanks all. Can we also add a dashboard alert for preview vs raw ingestion ratio crossing 10% per-tenant? This would've caught it earlier.
lina: I can add a lightweight Grafana alert and a console notification rule. Will follow up with a PR.
raj: Great. Keep thread updates here and paste PR links and runbook steps. we should target patch + rollback complete in the next 2 hours.
kevin: PR: github.com/redwood/billing-ingest/pulls/1225 (draft)
maria: rollback done on canary, monitoring now.
ana: monitoring shows preview delta dropping back to baseline for canary. closing loop once reconcile run completes.
billing-bot: [info] reconcile job queued for cohort snapshot id 2026-03-19T03:00Z-canary
ana: I'll open a postmortem doc with timeline and action items after reconcile. Thanks team :heart:
